title: Fenghuang: China's Prettiest Town, or a Theme Park? | China Travel Expert
description:
Fenghuang is either China's most beautiful riverside town or one big night-market theme park — tell me which, because I go back and forth.

Fenghuang Ancient Town sits on the Tuo River in western Hunan, and its wooden stilt houses (吊脚楼) have leaned over the water for roughly 1,300 years. Walking the riverbanks, bridges and lanes is completely free; you only pay if you want the sights — a two-day combined ticket is about ¥128 and covers nine attractions, including Shen Congwen's former residence and the Tuojiang River boat ride. By day it can feel like a living town; by night the bars, lanterns and cruise boats pack in the crowds. Real place, or a set built for tourists? That's the debate.

🧭 Expert Tip: sleep over instead of day-tripping — the dawn river with the mist and near-empty lanes is a completely different (and free) Fenghuang from the night-market crush.
